Thanks again for your time today, Daniel — great discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

- Objective: validate Redwood Inference for clinical summarization workflows and triage routing for Acme Health pilot clinics.
- Proposed POC scope: 2-week trial on a subset of anonymized notes (~10k tokens/day) + integration verification with your routing logic.
- Success criteria (draft attached):
  - Summaries meet clinical accuracy threshold on blinded review (>90% top-1 acceptance)
  - Latency p95 <150ms for 1k-token context in staging
  - Integrations pass end-to-end routing and fallbacks

Proposed timeline: kick off environment setup week of June 7, run June 9–June 21, final readout week of June 14 (exec review window June 15–16).

- Can you confirm the primary stakeholders (technical and exec) and procurement timeline?

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Subject: RE: Post-call recap + proposed POC plan — technical runbook & success metrics

Hi all — quick technical plan and proposed acceptance criteria from SE: 

Technical setup (high level):
- Staging environment: dedicated model variant with prefix caching disabled for initial evaluation.
- Data: customer-managed S3 bucket with short-lived ingestion credentials; we will not persist raw PHI on our hosted logs (see SOC2 summary).
- Integration: simple HTTP webhook for routing verification; fallbacks to stub responses for edge cases.

Test plan / acceptance criteria:
1) Accuracy: blinded clinician review on a 200-sample test set — target >=92% pass rate on core clinical summary rubric.
2) Latency: p95 <200ms, p99 <350ms in staging under expected concurrency (5 TPS).
3) Cost/efficiency: estimated token cost for pilot <= $0.002/token (we'll provide a line-item estimate).
4) Reliability: error rate <0.5% and successful end-to-end routing for 98% of test cases.

Deliverables & timeline:
- June 7: credentials + staging access
- June 9: ingestion + smoke tests
- June 9–21: evaluation window
- June 14/15: final readout (internal exec + Acme exec review)

I'll attach a short technical runbook (technical-setup.md) to this thread and post steps in the shared Drive. Marcus

Attachment: technical-setup.md
